name: Corporate Action Taxable Income Per Share Calculated 1 Code
definition: Specifies whether the fund calculates the taxable income per dividend/taxable income per share (TID/TIS).

TDIY.name: Calculated
TDIY.definition: Fund is calculating the taxable income per dividend/taxable income per share.

TDIN.name: Not Calculated
TDIN.definition: Fund is not calculating the taxable income per dividend/taxable income per share.

UKWN.name: Unknown
UKWN.definition: Unknown whether the fund is calculating the taxable income per dividend/taxable income per share.
